entries.title: Martha Is Dead

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for uncut capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is uncut, has PC capture/settings flexibility, and avoids the sourced PlayStation edits to interactive graphic scenes and references.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Martha Is Dead on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Avoid the PlayStation versions if you want the uncut archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release, documented as uncut relative to the PlayStation versions.
all_releases.reason: primary: uncut content plus PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox console releases, documented as uncut relative to the PlayStation versions.
all_releases.reason: skip: uncut console route, but no sourced capture/settings advantage over Windows PC.
skip: sourced edits remove interactivity from some graphic scenes and remove certain references, so this is not the complete-content route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PlayStation versions are edited, while PC and Xbox are documented as uncut. Windows PC wins because it is both uncut and the best capture/settings route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; key caveat is PlayStation content editing, not a remaster/remake split.
